_comment: Resource accounting for the KuaiRand-Pure autonomous agent run. Token figures are recovered from the Claude Agent SDK session transcripts under ~/.claude/projects (the in-process counter in run_agent.py read 0 because the Pro-subscription transport does not populate ResultMessage.usage; see RESULTS.md 'Note on token accounting').
experiment_runs_note: One agent iteration = one hypothesis -> experiment -> evaluate -> reflect cycle. A single iteration may spend many training runs, because the `tune` tool runs a BO+ASHA batch (up to 16 trials) inside one hypothesis. 153 is the number of rows in runs/journal.jsonl; 45 is the number of distinct agent hypotheses.
llm_cost_note: Claude Pro subscription via the Claude Agent SDK on the Claude Code CLI transport; no metered API spend. 87% of input tokens were cache reads, which is the effect of holding the scaffold + journal digest stable across turns.
agent_wall_clock_note: Union of the 10 Agent SDK session spans (8 research sessions + 2 guard smoke tests).
experiment_compute_note: Sum of per-iteration wall_clock_s in runs/journal.jsonl. Exceeds the agent wall clock because some BO batches were dispatched as detached background jobs.
manual_interventions_note: Zero in-loop interventions: no experiment was hand-fixed, unblocked, or code-corrected while the loop was running. Every error and timeout in runs/RUN_LOG.md was recovered by the agent itself.
operator_directives_note: Two opening directives (directive_crossnets.md, directive_encoding.md) were supplied via --opening-move. They steer only the first N turns of a run and then expire; they set a research priority, they do not fix code or supply configs. Counted here for transparency.
